sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use [number] *éves* *vagyok* to state your age. Éves means “years old” in this construction.

Notice the word order: number first, then éves, then vagyok — literally ‘thirty years am.’ English flips this around (‘I am thirty years old’), so if you catch yourself wanting to start with ‘I am,’ pause and lead with the number instead. Once that order is automatic, stating your age becomes plug-and-play with any number you know.
